documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our regional logistics team requested discovery about approval delays. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves contradictory project status information, specifically that the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This creates uncertainty about the need for a discovery meeting and integration requirements.

claims.quote: Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that there is conflicting information regarding the project status and requirements. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify whether the project is currently paused and if there is agreement on the integration requirements? This will help us proceed effectively.
questions: Could you clarify whether the project is currently paused and if there is agreement on the integration requirements?
What specific concerns does the owner have about the requirement?
uncertainties: The project status and owner's disagreement about the requirement are unclear.
